```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(gt)

scarlet_fever <- read_csv("data/scarlet-fever-data.csv")

gt(head(scarlet_fever)) 

ggplot(scarlet_fever, aes(
  x = year,
  y = metric_value
)) +
  geom_line(colour = "maroon") +
  xlab("Year") +
  ylab("GP consultation rate") +
  ggtitle("Rate of Scarlet Fever consultations per year") 
```
